title: "1. Define the question: DietSwap"
---

## Your question

::: {.callout-note}
How do community composition, Shannon diversity, and count totals differ between AAM and AFR in the selected DietSwap samples?
:::

DietSwap is a gut microbiome dataset. The supplied selection contains one sample from each of 38 participants, labelled AAM (African American) and AFR (African). This exercise compares the selected cohorts at the supplied sampling stage; it does not analyse changes over the full study.

## Your dataset

Use **38 samples**, **119 features**, and the supplied groups **AAM (21) and AFR (17)**.

| Location | Folder |
|---|---|
| Inputs | `data/dietswap/` |
| Outputs | `results/dietswap/` |

## Your task

Follow the seven steps in order: define the question, preview results, meet the inputs, check them, run the analysis, explain the evidence, and write the report. Complete workspace setup before starting.
